protocol.final_semantics: source-symbolic equivalence and exact source arithmetic, numeric publication and unit/citations

operations.absolute: One accepted scalar claim; its absolute value. Never executed implicitly by Final.
operations.add: Two accepted scalar claims/constants, first + second.
operations.average: Two to eight explicitly selected accepted scalar claims/constants; arithmetic mean of selected members.
operations.divide: Two accepted scalar claims/constants, first / second; nonzero denominator.
operations.maximum: Two to eight explicitly selected accepted scalar claims/constants; maximum of selected members.
operations.minimum: Two to eight explicitly selected accepted scalar claims/constants; minimum of selected members.
operations.multiply: Two accepted scalar claims/constants, first * second. Scale conversions must be executed, not merely described.
operations.read: One source: numeric_catalog ID; copy its signed numeric value with exact source identity. No parameters. Reading does not certify relevance or financial units.
operations.subtract: Two accepted scalar claims/constants, first - second.
operations.sum: Two to eight explicitly selected accepted scalar claims/constants; sum all selected members, no implicit row or period selection.

rules.actions: Propose your own subgoal, operation and ordered inputs. No plan or next-step candidates are supplied. parameters must be {}. All outputs are scalar numeric derivations with source provenance; you must decide financial relevance, periods, signs and scales.
rules.inputs: read takes one source: ID from numeric_catalog. Other operations take accepted Claim IDs or listed constant: IDs, never raw source IDs, bare numbers, observations or subgoal names.
rules.pending: Only Update accept/reject is legal while an observation is pending. A read or computation is not usable until YOU accept it. Accepted claims are immutable.
rules.publication: Final requires no pending observation and one accepted answer Claim. result has exactly value (decimal string, no % sign, within 0.00001 of that Claim) and unit (context.answer_unit). Ratios answering a percentage question must actually be multiplied by 100 before Final; changing the printed value/unit is not an executed conversion. citations must be unique and exactly the answer Claim's lineage. No host arithmetic repair.
rules.reason_limit: Action reason: at most 480 characters; subgoal: at most 240 characters.
rules.state_id: Copy state.id exactly for every submission.
rules.verification_scope: Intermediate validity is numeric and source-lexical, not correct financial use. Final must establish the original question's financial target with source-anchored algebra, not just coincidentally match its number. Alternative arithmetic grouping is permitted. Unsupported alternative evidence equivalences can remain outside this bounded oracle.
